A port/wrapper app to run CrossCode on Android devices developed by Namnodorel and rumpnisse.

Contributors:
• Ichiki Hayaite aka TheSparkstarScope - Contributed the awesome pixelart
• Dmytro Meleshko - Enhanced modloader support
• Alyxia & Xinto - CCLoader3 support
• krypek - Changed CrossCode instance format loading from .obb files to a regular directory

Looks like there was an error in the app! Please report the log message you can copy below.
The \'assets\' folder was not found in the game folder.
The game files are incomplete: assets/node-webkit.html is missing. Copy your full CrossCode installation again.

A game folder exists but the app is not allowed to read it:
%1$s

This happens when the folder was moved there with adb shell commands (mv/cp) or a file manager (e.g. via Shizuku): the files then belong to a different user and the app cannot repair this. A plain adb push works fine.

Instead, use the "Import game folder" button to copy the files safely.
Copy game folder to android/data on

The unreadable game folder was renamed to:
%1$s

The app cannot delete it. To free the space, remove it from a computer with:
adb shell rm -r "%1$s"
No file picker available on this device. Use adb push instead.
